from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def model(p):
    w,q,ph=p[0],p[1],p[2]
    tt=t**q
    C=np.cos(w*tt+ph); S=np.sin(w*tt+ph)
    A=np.column_stack([np.ones_like(x),x,np.log(x),1/v,v,x**3,C,S,C/v,S/v])
    return A
def resid(p):
    A=model(p)
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    return (A@c-dv_dt)/np.std(dv_dt)
